title: invoice-export · Acme Widgets session
heading: About this page
intro_html:
Answer what is waiting on you, run the checks, tick the log entries you have read, then Copy my replies and paste the text into chat.

To reopen: the link in your artifact list titled invoice-export · Acme Widgets session.

questions.ask: Which date format should the CSV export use?
questions.why_html: Your accountant's import tool rejected the last file. Both formats below open in a spreadsheet.

options.label: ISO dates (2026-03-14)
options.note_html: Sorts correctly everywhere; what most import tools expect.

options.label: US dates (03/14/2026)
options.note_html: Matches what people read on the invoice, but sorts wrong as text.

questions.ask: Can I push the settings fix to the branch?

qa.check: Export last month's invoices and open the file
qa.why_html: Expected: one row per invoice, totals match the screen. I could not open a real spreadsheet here.
qa.notes_label: If it failed, paste the first row

entries.title: Found it — the config change was never being used
entries.lede: The setting was read from the wrong file; fixed on the branch.

entries.title: Why the new setting changed nothing

decided.title: Export format
decided.decision: Plain CSV, one file per month
